description.value:
You’ve learned to always keep an imperceptible aura of magic around you, reinforcing your thoughts and body and merging with the energies of your mystic arts.

While conscious, you can add your Intelligence modifier to Concentration checks.
In addition, you gain each of the following bonus abilities, so long as you meet their requirements:


Requirement: The Spellarm ability.

While Spellarm is active, you are resistant to up to two of the spell’s damage types.


Requirement: The Sword and Sorcery ability.

When you cast a cantrip with a casting time of 1 action, you can take the Self-Defense action as a minor action.


Requirement: The Impossible Stance ability.

When you would be forced out of a Fighting Stance, such as from being knocked Prone or losing a Stance’s requirements, you can make a Concentration check to attempt to remain in your Fighting Stance regardless. On a success, you can remain in your stance so long as you correct the problem before the end of your next turn.

system.requirements: Must have the Wizard Starter Abilities
